'''Wicket33 Ewok Strike Team''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

Explosions and Fur.

The published list has 70 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck is excellent, winning both games in last tournament, and 1 in most previous tournaments over the last half-year. The primary goal of this deck is destroying the Bunker. Ewoks are used as defense against landing squads and battle damage. The start of my game works like this.

1: Pull two Generals (Madine and Solo if neither is in my hand). 2: Pull Chewie w/ Madine. 3: Pull Back Door w/ Shield Is Down. 4: Pull Bunker/Deactivate The Shield Generator. 5: Pull Lumat and Wuta w/ Chewie. 6: Pull Beezer w/ Madine. 7: Pull Portable Scanner w/ Beezer. 8: Pull Explosive Charges w/ Portable Scanner. 9: Pull Sentry w/ Madine. 10: Continue play according to opponent's strategy.

Jar Jar is used as my offensive tactic. He will select the weakest characters and slowly remove them from my opponent's locations, disappearing before retaliation; unless of course, he's the general. Beyond this the deck is a simple battle/drain deck.
